utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening today — I’m on it and will be there. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — I just wanted to make sure before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for organizing the repair drive, Opal. What details do you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check the community hall address and the parking access first? If those look good, I’ll fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll check the community hall address and parking access first, then report back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m getting the repair drive organized and ready. Dane, what should we prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’d start with the most urgent fixes first — anything that keeps people safe or gets the place usable again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — I’ll put safety and usability at the top of the list. I’ll start gathering the urgent repairs now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve heard they’re lining up a few folks to help fix small stuff around the neighborhood—things like bikes, shelves, and loose handles. If you want, I can check whether they need any tools or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I'm mostly hearing bits and pieces, so any details help. If they need extra hands, I might be able to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help—what’s the repair drive need first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I think we need a list of the urgent fixes first, then I can sort the donations by what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can start that list now—roof leaks, broken windows, and any electrical hazards first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plans to the neighbors and make sure everyone knows the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. Let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep everyone in the loop and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put you down or send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please put me down and send the details. I like having a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, and I’ll send the details right over so you can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely—folks are bringing in all sorts of things. If you’re thinking of helping out, it seems like a good day to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I should probably swing by with something useful—I’ll try not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely—just bring whatever’s been sitting around needing a fix, and they’ll sort it out. If you forget, I’ll probably see you on the street and remind you!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I need to know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’m trying to pin down the timing so we can plan it properly. I’ll let you know as soon as I have a date.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — just let me know as soon as you have the date, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a bit behind on the details, but I know it’s still moving along. I can check and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo—just let me know when you’ve checked. I’m happy to help if there’s anything to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — I don’t think anything changed yet, I just wanted to check in and see if you’re still able to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still able to help. Just point me to what needs doing and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going? Do you need me to bring anything by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s going pretty well, thanks. If you can bring tape and a box of screws, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can drop off tape and a box of screws later today. Anything else you need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to make sure we’ve got the timing and drop-off details sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — I can check around and see what people are saying about the timing and drop-off. I’ll get back to you as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell — that would help a lot. Once you know the timing and drop-off spot, let me know and I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is ready to go?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got the tools lined up and I’m ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — you’re actually ready to head out, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — I like to keep it simple. If you’ve got the repair drive details, I’m ready to hear the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s meet by the north path entrance at 3 PM, and I’ll bring the repair drive list with the room numbers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll meet you by the north path entrance at 3 PM. I’ll be ready for the repair drive list and room numbers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and remind folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an ear out if anyone has questions.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll keep reminding people and send them your way if they have questions.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa, I’m hearing the repair drive is coming together fast — want me to pass along an invite and see if you can join us?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be great, Quinn — please send it my way. I’d love to see the details and help out if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details right away and make sure you’re in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Glad you made it. We still need help sorting donations and setting up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the donation sorting and help with the tables too—where do you want me first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today. Let me know what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — low-key is perfect. I’ve got a short list if you’re up for it: the loose gate latch and that leaky faucet are the main ones.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can take a look at the gate latch first, then the faucet if I’ve got the energy. Keep it quiet and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to check on the first stop now, then I’ll swing by the others and let you know what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Text me what you find at the first stop, and I’ll help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got and note what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. Just keep me posted on what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check our supplies and let you know what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you let people know we need volunteers with tools, a few spare parts, and anyone who can help sort repairs on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll pass that along and ask around for volunteers with tools, spare parts, and sorting help on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. We still need a few people to sort the donated tools and figure out who’s bringing the extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donated tools, and I’ll bring my extension cord too. If you want, I can also help make a quick list of who still needs to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m just checking the details first — what’s already been collected, and what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I’m not sure yet — I might’ve missed a few updates. Can you remind me what’s already been collected?
